name: todo-api

dependencies.name: thunder
dependencies.description: Verifies the gateway's signed assertion for every call and enforces the todos scopes.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Persists each user's todo items across sessions and devices.

description: The backend for the todo app: exposes /me/todos to list, create, update and delete the signed-in caller's own todos, persisting them in its Postgres database. It never sees another user's todos and performs no cross-user aggregation.
